artifacts.notes: Entire displayed speech apart from 14 explicitly omitted bracketed editorial interventions, from the opening repeal paragraph through the concluding Pennsylvania/Ohio/Indiana sentence. 125 source paragraphs retained. This derivative is not a collation to the 1854 publication or a reproduction of Basler’s complete modern apparatus.
artifacts.rights_basis: Lincoln’s 1854 English speech is public domain in the United States by publication date. Only its historical text is retained; the modern introduction and square-bracketed editorial interventions are omitted rather than treated as Lincoln’s words.

edition.publication: Lincoln Home National Historic Site, National Park Service; page last updated April 10, 2015; source attributed to Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, edited by Roy P. Basler
edition.title: Peoria Speech, October 16, 1854 — National Park Service transcription
